title: Domain IAM
pageSubtitle: Manage user groups and their members in this domain. Assign a group's project access in Project management.
denied: Only managers of this domain can manage groups.
domainMismatch: The response domain differs from your current session domain. Sign in again.
name: Name
protectedHelp: Only a system administrator can change a group with grants outside this domain or at administrator level.
nameHelp: Enter 1–64 characters without leading or trailing spaces.
roleNote: Review and assign the group's project roles in Project management.
noCandidates: There are no active users to add.
deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} group? Its members lose the project access they received through this group.
errorNotFound: The group was not found. Refresh the list.
errorNameExists: A group with the same name already exists.
errorReadOnly: Domain managers cannot change this group.
errorReserved: A system-managed group name or description cannot be used.
errorMemberExists: The user is already a member of this group.
errorMemberNotFound: The user is not a member of this group. Refresh the list.
errorPrivileged: Protected accounts cannot be changed in domain IAM.
errorNotJoined: Only active users who joined this domain can be added.
errorOwnerGrant: A group with project owner grants cannot be changed without an ownership transfer.
ssoMappedHelp: An operator SSO mapping finds this group by name. Renaming or deleting it would stop SSO login for the domain, so only the description and local members can change. Members added by the SSO mapping are not shown in the list or the member count.
errorNameReserved: An operator SSO mapping uses this name, so it cannot be given to another group.
